Chapter 787: Chapter 10 The Descent of Martial Ancestor (Please Subscribe)

Consciousness began to awaken.

Lin Yuan gradually took ownership of the Martial Ancestor Golden Body.

“Back to the Tianqing World…”

Lin Yuan extended a sliver of psychic power into the Demon Tree, “The Ancestral Demon Tree’s injuries are so severe?”

With just preliminary perception, Lin Yuan noticed that the injuries of the Ancestral Demon Tree had already affected its roots.

Otherwise, it wouldn’t have used terms like life and death in its plea for help to describe the situation in Tianqing World.

...

“But it doesn’t matter much.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even while nurturing the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, the Ancestral Demon Tree had already become less important to Lin Yuan.

As soon as the Martial Ancestor Golden Body took shape, it reached the Eighth Layer, surpassing the peak period of the Ancestral Demon Tree. After more than one hundred thousand years of nurturing, it had already half-stepped into the Ninth Rank.

In simple terms, as long as Lin Yuan had half an hour to smoothly take over the Martial Ancestor Golden Body.

Directly, he would possess the basic Ninth Rank combat power, plus a high degree of intuition for the laws and mastery over the use of power.

He could even sweep through Tenth Rank Life.

In a desperate battle, pulling out all the stops could unleash Tier 11 combat power.

In this realm, the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, after being nurtured for hundreds of thousands of years, had an unfathomably profound foundation.

Especially with Lin Yuan, the Ancestor of Martial Arts taking charge, every ounce of power could be fully unleashed.

Together, their combined effect far exceeded the sum of their parts.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan’s mind merged with the Ancestral Demon Tree, beginning to receive detailed information from the past several hundred thousand years.

Even though Lin Yuan could receive messages from the Ancestral Demon Tree while he was in the Main Universe, thanks to the connection between them,

The information was incredibly simplified, with many major events from those hundreds of thousands of years often described in just one sentence.

After all, they were separated by different dimensions, and even with the Door to the Myriad Realms acting as a ‘transfer’ point, it was extremely difficult to convey messages, so the more simplified, the better.

Lin Yuan was unaware of many details.

“Hm?”

“No wonder the Tianqing World has attracted the attention and even invasion of those two Foreign Evil Gods. No, it’s not the idea of those two Foreign Evil Gods, but their ‘Pavilion Master’ behind them.”

Lin Yuan’s thought process was incredibly fast. It took him only a dozen breaths to understand everything that had happened over several hundred thousand years, clear as day.

Especially the tactics used by those two Foreign Evil Gods at the end to severely injure the Ancestral Demon Tree and tear open the barriers of the Tianqing World, certainly came from an even more powerful Foreign Evil God.

According to the intelligence Lin Yuan had, in the Boundless Void near Tianqing World, the most powerful Foreign Evil God had established a force called ‘Black Demon Pavilion’, declared itself the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master, and ruled over a large number of Foreign Evil Gods.

Of course, in the more distant Boundless Void, other powerful Foreign Evil Gods existed, establishing their own forces or gathering places and dominating certain regions.

“Over the past several hundred thousand years, Tianqing World’s Origin Source has strengthened at least tenfold under my influence.”

Lin Yuan, through the perspective of the Ancestral Demon Tree, looked toward the vast Origin Source of Tianqing World.

After replacing the Heavenly Dao of Tianqing World, Lin Yuan began to deliberately manipulate it, making the flow of Tianqing World’s Origin Source more perfect and complete.

Late, after the shuttle ended and he returned to the Main Universe, Lin Yuan still had the Ancestral Demon Tree adjust the flow of the entire Tianqing World’s Origin Source.

With his incredibly fast comprehension, Lin Yuan observed the operation of the Main Universe, then applied it to the Tianqing World, making the Tianqing World move closer to the Main Universe.

How vast is the Main Universe? Its scale, let alone Tianqing World, even the Boundless Void cannot compare, and the efficiency of the Main Universe’s Origin Source operation naturally far surpasses that of the Tianqing World.

The Tianqing World imitating the Main Universe’s Origin Source operation might not show results in the short term, but over tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, the difference becomes evident.

As a result, the Origin Source of today’s Tianqing World is ten times that of several hundred thousand years ago.

This still assumes Lin Yuan, in order to nurture the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, hadn’t expended the world’s Origin Source so drastically; otherwise, the difference might have been dozens of times or nearly a hundred times greater.

Such changes in Tianqing World inevitably drew the attention of other Foreign Evil Gods in the vicinity.

The original Tianqing World, with its weak Origin Source and the protection of the Ancestral Demon Tree,

Those Foreign Evil Gods might’ve had ideas but would not act because the effort wasn’t worth the potential loss, requiring a brutal battle even if they were to prevail.

But Tianqing World, with an Origin Source strengthened more than tenfold, was different.

The key issue, however, might be the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master wanting to figure out why, in just a few hundred thousand years, Tianqing World had undergone such changes.

If it could master this transformation, wouldn’t the efficiency of devouring the Origin Source of other worlds greatly increase?

This was also the key reason why Tianqing World was invaded.

If it were just the Tianqing World as it originally was, it would not have attracted the attention of the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master.

“Although it has been invaded, there haven’t been many casualties amongst the beings of this world.”

Lin Yuan, borrowing the viewpoint of the Ancestral Demon Tree and incarnating as the Heavenly Dao, observed every little detail of this realm.

Mainly, it was because the Ancestral Demon Tree had issued orders in time for the beings of Tianqing World to gather around it.

By using the power of the Demon Tree itself for protection, they managed to preserve the vast majority of Tianqing World’s power.

Of course, as time passed, and the two Foreign Evil Gods kept infiltrating, the Ancestral Demon Tree’s injuries grew heavier.

It was foreseeable that the damage to the beings of Tianqing World would start to skyrocket.

“Hmm?”

“The sacrifice has ended?”

Lin Yuan cast his gaze towards the great hall, where countless believers respectfully rose, an inexplicable resonance of heavenly and earthly aura subtly flowed into the golden body.
